svg.title: ctxtra hooks into every agent. Bindings add your own instruction files and a pinned team package to sessions by folder or Git remote, worktrees included. An edited file reaches every matching session, a team update waits for your review, and nothing is written into the repos

g.text: ctxtra hooks into every agent you use.
Your own instructions reach every session.
Bind more by folder or Git remote. Worktrees match too.
Add your team's package. It brings its own bindings.
Edit a file once. Every matching session gets it, in every agent.
Team files stay at the commit you accepted, until you take the update.
Nothing is written into your repos.
